answers.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
answers.evidence: Of 80 confirmed judged findings (the 9 tool findings excluded), 50 map to a ground-truth defect, 7 are real but not seeded (F-0034, F-0035, F-0053, F-0074, F-0079, F-0092, F-0106) and 23 are not problems (design-polish and taste remarks such as the wrench placeholder, branding, alignment, the footer band, wrapped nav labels, the badge-shape and missing-month-label items), so precision = 57/80 = 0.71, below 0.8; strict precision = 50/80 = 0.63 (35/80 = 0.44 against the thirteen originally seeded defects). Recall by meaning is 24/26 overall and 12/13 seeded: no finding is about D24, and D13 appears only in the last sentence of F-0072, which maps to D22.

answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply's 'Fix first (in this order)' list runs 1 to 7 with the basket hold marked P0 at the top, followed by 'Also worth fixing'. It names what it could not check, 'Not tested: real VoiceOver or TalkBack, real phones, and real members', and says none of the review comes from real members.

mapping.title: Drill name clips under text-spacing override
mapping.reason: Same one-line, cut-off tool names on the find page as D03; with extra text spacing the drill name is clipped again even at 1280 px, and letting names wrap fixes both.

mapping.title: Tab jumps from the last tool back up to Search tools
mapping.reason: Focus order between the results and the search form runs against the visual order on the find page, which is D01's focus-order clause caused by the CSS reorder of form and list; the review reads the DOM order the other way round from the ground truth, but it is the same reorder.

mapping.title: Fixed action bar hides the focused loan-length button
mapping.reason: The fixed 'Reserve this tool' bar paints over a focused control on the tool page because nothing keeps the page clear of it; D08 cites day buttons, but the defect is the bar covering whatever control receives focus.

mapping.title: Masthead link never reached in a Tab walk
mapping.reason: In the loan-open state Tab cannot leave the open loan-length list, so the walk never reaches the masthead link; this is the D09 trap seen from what it blocks (criterion A11Y-25), and fixing the trap fixes it.

mapping.title: Basket sessions shown in reverse of DOM and arrow-key order
mapping.reason: Exactly D11: the session cards are laid out in reverse, so Saturday 10 is last on screen while first for Tab, arrow keys and screen readers.

mapping.title: Loan-length control named by its value, not its label
mapping.reason: Exactly D16: the loan-length button is announced as 'One week, button, collapsed' with no mention of what is being chosen.

mapping.title: Session dots vanish in forced colours at phone widths
mapping.reason: The same dot-only session marker that replaces 'Open' below 480 px (D20); in forced colours it disappears altogether, and keeping a visible word at phone widths fixes both.

mapping.title: No-match search shows no message and announces nothing
mapping.reason: D02: a search for 'sewing machine' leaves a full list on screen with an empty status region and no 'no tools match' message.

mapping.title: Collection day chosen twice, first choice not carried over
mapping.reason: Main point is D23: the day picked on the tool page must be chosen again as a session in the basket, nothing preselected, with a 'Choose a pick-up session' error; its remarks on closed days and mismatched dates are secondary.

mapping.title: Tool-card headings at the same level as their section heading
mapping.reason: Screen-reader members who move by headings get the ten tool names at the same level as 'Search', 'Tools' and 'Opening times', so the outline does not show which headings are tools and level navigation cannot skip the list; not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' outside every landmark
mapping.reason: The page's main action sits outside main and every region, so a screen-reader member who navigates by landmarks and explores main does not find the Reserve button there; minor but genuine, and not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Second Confirm press makes a second reservation
mapping.reason: Exactly D12: Confirm stays enabled during the 1.5 s wait and a repeat press allocates a second reservation number.

mapping.title: No visible busy state on Continue and Confirm
mapping.reason: Confirm stays enabled with nothing visible happening during its 1.5 s wait, which is D12; a visible, disabled busy state fixes it (the Continue half is the same pattern).

mapping.title: Tab cycles inside the open loan-length list
mapping.reason: Exactly D09: Tab moves to the next option and wraps, so a keyboard user cannot leave the open list.

mapping.title: Basket hold expires with no notice, warning or extension
mapping.reason: D10: 'Items are held for you while you finish' shows no time although the hold lasts ten minutes.

mapping.title: Expired hold makes every Continue fail with 'Something went wrong'
mapping.reason: D10's lapsed-hold path: Continue answers 'Something went wrong. Try again.', which states neither the cause nor a working fix; the review adds that retries keep failing.

mapping.title: Closed days can be chosen and are rejected only at confirm
mapping.reason: Exactly D06: every day is selectable and a closed day is refused only on the confirm page, with no way back to the calendar.

mapping.title: Tab reaches results before the search form above it
mapping.reason: Same CSS reorder of the search form and results on the find page with focus order against the visual order (D01's focus-order clause); the review places it above 480 px with the DOM order reversed relative to the ground truth, but it is the same mechanism.

mapping.title: Basket sessions shown in reverse, bottom-up order
mapping.reason: D11: sessions display Wednesday 28 to Saturday 10 while reading and arrow-key order run the other way.

mapping.title: 330 px column minimum overflows the 320 px viewport
mapping.reason: Exactly D05: minmax(330px) in a 288 px content box makes the cards overflow by about 42 px.

mapping.title: Card names cut to one line, hiding what tells the drills apart
mapping.reason: Exactly D03: nowrap with ellipsis hides 'two batteries' vs 'one battery' and the full name is nowhere else on the card.

mapping.title: Dark-mode green badge below contrast, no tint
mapping.reason: Exactly D04: #2f7d4a text on the #1d2622 card surface at about 3.1:1 for 16 px bold text.

mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first' not announced or tied to the calendar
mapping.reason: Exactly D19: the error is a plain paragraph, not a live region and not referenced by the calendar, so a screen reader announces only the focused day.

mapping.title: 'Available from' hint not linked to its input
mapping.reason: A screen-reader member tabbing to the date field is not read the hint that explains what the date means, because the input has no aria-describedby; not in the ground truth (D25 concerns the hint's wording, not its association).

mapping.title: 'Added to your basket' toast gone after about 1.3 s
mapping.reason: D07: the only feedback after the press is a toast that disappears almost at once, leaving the small header count as the only cue.

mapping.title: Search field below the whole tool list on phones
mapping.reason: D01: on phones the ten cards come first and the search sits about 2000 px down with no hint that it exists.

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' only adds to a basket
mapping.reason: Its harm is that the reservation looks done when a basket, a session and a confirmation still follow, the false belief D26 describes.

mapping.title: Basket confirmation vanishes, way on scrolled out of view
mapping.reason: About the feedback after the press: the toast is gone in seconds, the only lasting sign is the header count out of view, and nothing nearby leads on, which is D07 rather than D26's false belief.

mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed latest first
mapping.reason: The visual side of D11: the reversed layout puts Wednesday 28 first and the wanted Saturday 17 fourth of six.

mapping.title: Header still shows Basket (1) after confirming
mapping.reason: D18: the basket is not emptied after 'Reservation confirmed', so the header keeps 'Basket (1)'.

mapping.title: Date filter hidden behind an icon-only Filters button
mapping.reason: D01 names the icon-only three-line button as the only way to the 'Available from' date and the category filter.

mapping.title: Calendar accepts days the library is closed
mapping.reason: D06: Monday 12 October can be chosen and is accepted into the basket with no word that the library is closed.

mapping.title: Calendar accepts days before the tool is available
mapping.reason: Exactly D14: a day before the pressure washer's 'Available from' date is accepted without warning.

mapping.title: Change from confirm clears details already typed
mapping.reason: Main point is D22: after Change, the basket and Continue, the membership number and name are empty; its last sentence (session not preselected) is D13.

mapping.title: Reservation number looks like a membership number
mapping.reason: Both identifiers use the 'FT-' prefix, so a member reading 'FT-4471' on the done page, or asked for one number at the desk, can give the other; not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Membership-number error does not say what is wrong
mapping.reason: The same unforgiving membership-number check on the confirm page, whose error only repeats the example instead of saying what is wrong with what was typed; part of D17.

mapping.title: No lasting sign that the tool is in the basket
mapping.reason: D07: after the short toast the page looks unchanged and only the off-screen header count records the press.

mapping.title: Basket does not say how long tools are held
mapping.reason: D10: 'held for you while you finish' with no time shown for a ten-minute hold.

mapping.title: Remove empties the basket with no undo
mapping.reason: One mis-tap on 'Remove' on a phone loses the item with no undo, and getting it back means finding the tool and re-choosing loan length and day; not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Basket accepts a session before a held tool is available
mapping.reason: D14: the basket offers every session and nothing checks the tools' 'Available from' dates.

mapping.title: Fourth tool accepted despite the three-tool limit
mapping.reason: Exactly D21: the stated limit of three is not enforced and four tools go through to confirm.

mapping.title: Date-filter hint contradicts what the filter keeps
mapping.reason: Exactly D25: the hint says 'on or after this day' while the filter hides a tool collectable after the chosen day.

mapping.title: Stale session error with dead link after emptying the basket
mapping.reason: After the last tool is removed the empty basket still says 'Choose a pick-up session' and links to a list that is gone, telling the member to do something impossible; minor, not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Date-filter results change out of view on phones
mapping.reason: Caused by D01's phone layout, which puts the filter panel below the list; putting the form above the list, as D01 requires, fixes it.

mapping.title: Every calendar day is a Tab stop, arrow keys do nothing
mapping.reason: Keyboard and switch members must step through up to 21 day buttons to get past the calendar to 'Reserve this tool', and the arrow keys a visual grid invites do nothing; minor, not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: +44 mobile number rejected
mapping.reason: D17 lists '+44 7700 900123' among the valid forms the confirm page rejects.

mapping.title: Same placeholder wrench on every tool card
mapping.reason: An appeal remark: the names identify the tools and nothing in the flow fails for lack of photos.

mapping.title: Drill names truncated identically on phones
mapping.reason: Exactly D03 at 375 px: both drills read 'Cordless drill 18 V, co...'.

mapping.title: Search and filter below all ten tools on phones
mapping.reason: D01's phone reordering of the tool list and the search form.

mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed latest-first
mapping.reason: Duplicate of the D11 reversed session layout.

mapping.title: Sessions before the chosen pick-up day are offered
mapping.reason: The basket offers sessions that contradict the day already chosen on the tool page and nothing reconciles the two, which is D15.

mapping.title: Session cards wrap into a ragged one-plus-five grid
mapping.reason: Desktop layout polish: the cards stay readable and selectable; the reversed order behind the layout is mapped separately to D11.

mapping.title: Unthemed native date input and default select
mapping.reason: Taste: native date and select controls work well on phones, and differing baselines hinder no one.

mapping.title: No-results search without an empty-state message
mapping.reason: D02: 'sewing machine' leaves tools on screen and no message says nothing matched.

mapping.title: Pick-up calendar has no month or year label
mapping.reason: The item only observes that the grid 'starts at Fr 9 and runs to Th 29 with weekday headers only' and that no 'October 2026' heading or month navigation is visible; it names no harm. Those dates are one unbroken run within a single month, so month navigation would add nothing, and the same review says the month is given as soon as a day is chosen ('the status line names the month only after a day is chosen', F-0131) and that the days are announced in full ('Saturday 17 October, open'). Nothing it shows gives a basis for a member misreading or mis-choosing the day, so the orientation harm is speculative; like the critics' other execution remarks, it is not a problem for members.

mapping.title: Reserve button off the content column
mapping.reason: Alignment at 1280 px is visual polish; the button is visible and works.

mapping.title: Details lists with different label column widths
mapping.reason: Visual polish; the details stay readable.

mapping.title: Dark theme drops the chip on green badges
mapping.reason: The complaint is shape, not legibility: in dark mode the green badges 'have no visible chip background' while the grey ones keep theirs, 'so the two badge variants no longer share a shape' (DES-coherence, severity 1). D04 is the text contrast of #2f7d4a on #1d2622 at 3.1:1; the item never mentions contrast or reading, and restoring the chip, the fix it implies, would not fix that contrast, since the review's own fix for D04 is the dark --color-ok text token, with the tinted background named only as an extra ('it should also get back the tinted background'). As with D07 and D26, the same badge read for a different harm is a different problem, and a shape mismatch between badge variants hinders no member, so not-a-problem.

mapping.title: Header still shows Basket (1) after confirming
mapping.reason: D18; duplicate of F-0062.

mapping.title: No brand identity beyond the name
mapping.reason: Brand and appeal critique; a matter of taste that does not affect reserving.

mapping.title: Grey band below the footer on short pages
mapping.reason: Visual polish at 1280 px; no effect on the task.

mapping.title: Navigation labels wrap on phones
mapping.reason: The wrapped labels stay legible and tappable; visual polish.

mapping.title: Open loan list and focused option under the fixed bar
mapping.reason: D08: the fixed Reserve bar covers the focused option because nothing keeps the page clear of it.

mapping.title: Action-bar button not aligned with the column
mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0118; visual polish.

mapping.title: Toast overlaps the calendar weekday header
mapping.reason: The toast covers one column header for about a second; no member is hindered.

mapping.title: Pick-up calendar has no month label
mapping.reason: Same observation as F-0117 ('dates 9-29 with no month or year caption'), and its own words show the gap closes at the point of choice: 'the status line names the month only after a day is chosen', before anything is reserved. With a single unbroken run of dates 9 to 29 and the days announced in full ('Saturday 17 October, open'), no harm to members is shown or follows; a design-hierarchy remark rather than a genuine problem.

mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed latest-first
mapping.reason: Duplicate of the D11 reversed session layout.

mapping.title: Orphan full-width session card
mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0114; layout polish.

mapping.title: Navigation labels break mid-phrase at 375 px
mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0125; the taller masthead scrolls away and the labels work.

mapping.title: Same wrench placeholder on every card
mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0110; appeal remark.

mapping.title: Brand is just the name beside a stock icon
mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0123; taste.

mapping.title: Tool names truncate at 375 px
mapping.reason: Exactly D03: the two drills become indistinguishable.

mapping.title: Search below all ten cards on phones
mapping.reason: D01's phone reordering of the tool list and the search form.

mapping.title: Session cards: one wide card over five cramped ones
mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0114; desktop layout polish.

mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed latest first
mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0060, the D11 reversed layout.

mapping.title: Details lists use two value-column offsets
mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0119; visual polish.

mapping.title: Toast covers the calendar weekday header
mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0130; negligible.

mapping.title: Grey band below the footer at 1280 px
mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0124; visual polish.

mapping.title: Right half of the 1280 px layout empty
mapping.reason: A narrow reading column on short pages is a layout choice, not a problem for members.

mapping.title: Dark theme: green badges lose their pill
mapping.reason: Same as F-0120: green badges 'render as plain green text while grey ... badges keep a filled pill' (DES-coherence, severity 1). It reports the lost pill as an inconsistency with the grey badges and does not say the text is hard to read, so it does not raise D04's legibility fault, and fixing the pill would leave D04's 3.1:1 text in place (the review fixes that through the dark --color-ok token). A badge-shape inconsistency is a design-coherence matter, not a problem for members.

mapping.title: axe contrast failure on the dark green badge
mapping.reason: 3.07:1 for #2f7d4a on #1d2622, exactly D04.

mapping.title: 'Available from Sat 10 Oct' at 3.07:1 in dark
mapping.reason: Exactly D04.

mapping.title: Day button and Reserve button 0 px apart at 768 px
mapping.reason: At 768 px the fixed Reserve bar lies over the second row of days, so Saturday 17 and the bar touch; the same bar-over-calendar defect D08 describes for that width.

mapping.title: Drill name clips at 200 % text size
mapping.reason: The one-line, cut-off card names of D03, clipped again at larger text.

mapping.title: Horizontal overflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: Exactly D05: the page scrolls sideways by 26 px.

mapping.title: No reflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: Same measurement as F-0012; D05.

mapping.title: Drill name clipped at 320 px
mapping.reason: The card name overflows its one-line box at phone width; D03.

mapping.title: Card text 9.7 px from the right edge at 320 px
mapping.reason: The cards running past the 288 px content box (D05) push their text to within 10 px of the edge; fixing the column minimum restores the gutter.

mapping.title: Cramped 6.4 px padding in a tool card
mapping.reason: A spacing-rule measurement with no sign that it hinders reading or tapping.
